note: Lifecycle: locked -> active -> completed -> rewarded. 'start_flags' activate a locked quest, 'complete_flags' complete it, and the reward is granted once (tracked in rewards_claimed). Chapter 1 quests follow docs/chapter-01/data/chapter-01-quests.json.

journal.active: Lumi is waiting somewhere in Root Square.
journal.completed: Lumi joined the adventure. Well, the short, careful visit.

journal.active: Bobo will trade his lantern for the parcel a Leafling took into the Training Glade.
journal.completed: Bobo got his parcel back. We have a lantern!

journal.active: Find the gate key and a way across the Whispering Roots.
journal.completed: We found the gate key and rebuilt the root bridge.

journal.active: Something guards the Forbidden Gate.
journal.completed: The Thornkeeper let us pass. It said the promise hasn't ended.

journal.active: Open the Forbidden Gate and cross into the human world.
journal.completed: We made it to Sungai Melor!

journal.active: Humans can't see us! Find out how to get to Bandar Senja. Old Kettle in the kopitiam knows things.
journal.completed: We sorted Encik Lim's coins. Old Kettle told us the bus trick.

journal.active: Board the bus at the village road stop. Follow someone with a big load.
journal.completed: We rode the bus to Bandar Senja, on the luggage rack.

journal.active: A fisherman dropped his postcard on the jetty. Post it in Bandar Senja. Maybe the post box knows how.
journal.completed: Mr Slot took the postcard.

journal.active: Put Pak Darus's three parcels back on his desk while he isn't looking. A: the goods shed (west). B: the rail yard (through the hall). C: sent to the wrong shop on Shophouse Row (east).
journal.completed: All three parcels are back. The Clockkeeper owes us tickets.

journal.active: Parcel B is in a moth nest on a rail yard siding. Set the three signal levers to send the handcar there. Lumi's Echo Sight can show the old route.
journal.completed: We beat the Paper Moth Monarch and got Parcel B back. We learned Guardian Bloom.

journal.active: A 1951 parcel tag on the goods shed's high shelf has the same emblem as Reno's token. Lumi could read it with Memory Touch.
journal.completed: Footsteps on a platform, and a woman's voice: "Mind the gap, little one."

journal.active: Board the evening train at Platform 2 (north door of the Station Hall).
journal.completed: We boarded. Then the fog came.

journal.active: The passengers have lost where they were going. Memory Moths carry glowing slips. Get them back and give each slip to the passenger it belongs to.
journal.completed: Three passengers remember where they're going. The Guard's Van is open.

journal.active: Someone in the Guard's Van is collecting everyone's destinations. Our stamped tickets should keep ours safe.
journal.completed: The Conductor remembered he used to carry people home.

journal.active: The train has stopped at a ghost platform.
journal.completed: The river route is open. The rails forget; the river remembers.

journal.active: The lantern showed a Veil keyhole on a trunk in the Luggage Van. Something inside is grumpy.
journal.completed: We calmed the Lost Luggage and found a Brass Lantern Hook.

journal.active: The river below Bandar Senja is flowing the wrong way.
journal.completed: The Kingfisher sisters say Nenek Arus is forgetting the Tide Song.

journal.active: Find the three verses of the Tide Song. Pak Lumpur in the Mangrove Walk (east of the landing) has the first. Old Pole in Kampung Air has the second. The third is somewhere at the Sunken Jetty.
journal.completed: We have all three verses of the Tide Song.

journal.active: The Veil boat is waiting at Senja River Landing. Ride it down to the Drowned Crossing.
journal.completed: The Undertow let go of everything it was keeping.

journal.active: Nenek Arus is waiting at her pool.
journal.completed: Someone cut part of Nenek Arus's name from the Book of Names. The ink smelled of Bandar Kencana.

journal.active: The river has been keeping lost things. Find a toy boat (Mangrove Walk), a bicycle bell (Kampung Air) and a wedding ring (Sunken Jetty), and put them in the fisherman's tackle box at the landing while he isn't looking.
journal.completed: Three lost things went home.

journal.active: Bandar Kencana is forgetting its own name. Something is crackling in the radio shop (north side of the wharf).
journal.completed: Elias, a spirit who lives in radios, joined us.

journal.active: The photo studio has three old photographs with blank captions. Lumi's Memory Touch can show what they were.
journal.completed: The town remembers its photographs. A crack into the Veil opened at the west end of the wharf.

journal.active: Three radio masts in Kencana-in-the-Veil. Read each plaque, and Elias can tune in an old broadcast.
journal.completed: KEN, CA, NA. The Hall of Records is open.

journal.active: Something in the Hall of Records keeps the town's page blank.
journal.completed: The Blank Clerk is gone, and the name is back.

journal.active: Bukit Getah's grove is full of frightened trees blocking the lanes. Reno can Forest Whisper to them (Reno leads).
journal.completed: The grove trees calmed down. Something small is hiding by the smokehouse.

journal.active: The grove's guardian is hiding in the smokehouse clearing. Talk to her gently.
journal.completed: Titis trusts us. Her fear came loose as a shadow.

journal.active: Titis's fear has a shape of its own now. Face it.
journal.completed: The Fear-Shadow is gone. The grove is quiet.

journal.active: Hutan Seribu Bunga is wilting. Someone is calling from the dead vines along the trail.
journal.completed: Maris, the sanctuary's keeper, joined us.

journal.active: Three memory blossoms in the Thousand Flowers hold what the sanctuary remembers. Maris can Regrow vine bridges over the stream; Lumi can read the blossoms.
journal.completed: We saw the Promise, a crying Oathkeeper, and the stranger planting forgetting seeds.

journal.active: The forgetting seeds have grown at the Heart of the Sanctuary.
journal.completed: The Forgetting Bloom wilted. The sanctuary is breathing again.

journal.active: Pasar Malam Impian, the midnight carnival. The star performer Taro says the man we want is in the Hall of Mirrors. Is he telling the truth?
journal.completed: Taro was lying. Then he joined us anyway.

journal.active: The Ghost Train goes to the Big Top. Pull the ride lever while the ticket-taker isn't looking, or let Taro make a Decoy.
journal.completed: We rode the Ghost Train. Reno screamed. Happily.

journal.active: The Ringmaster is hiding the stranger's trail behind illusions.
journal.completed: The Ringmaster told the truth, for once.

journal.active: Banjaran Awan, the Cloud Range. A thick mist hides the trail. Reno's Spirit Cyclone can blow it away.
journal.completed: The mist is gone. Something old is waiting at the Guardian's Gate.

journal.active: The guardian Galen thinks we came with the ink-fingered man. Prove him wrong.
journal.completed: Galen joined us. He knew the man, once.

journal.active: Galen can break the silent stones. The Oath Stone is at the summit.
journal.completed: The Hush is gone. The stone remembered a warning.

journal.active: Lumi, Maris and Elias hold the tear where the river spirit world is spilling into town.
journal.completed: The river tear is sealed.

journal.active: Reno, Taro and Galen hold the tear in the night market, where a human watchman is standing far too close.
journal.completed: The market tear is sealed.

journal.active: The last tear is on the old railway. Just Reno and Lumi, together.
journal.completed: We saw 1951. And we saw him.

journal.active: The Archive Between Worlds. Three catalogue gates block the stacks. Each one wants something we carried here.
journal.completed: The stacks are open.

journal.active: Lumi can read the memory pages of 1951 with Echo Sight.
journal.completed: Now we know what happened on the platform. And who we are.

journal.active: The Keeper is at his desk at the heart of the Archive. Show him Maya's page.
journal.completed: He ran to the First Crossing. This ends there.

journal.active: The First Crossing. The Keeper is putting out the lanterns on the oldest bridge there is. Each of our friends can relight one.
journal.completed: The bridge is lit again.

journal.active: Stop the Keeper at the heart of the Crossing, and bring him home.
journal.completed: The Promise is renewed. Everyone chose it.
